text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew, huff............ Alright... one 
more!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...She's here again.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just what time did they start this 
crap...? Every mornin' so early, it's 
suffocating.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'll get ready for training too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Phew...... That should do it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The recording is... all set. I'll review 
it once I get home—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...That person—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa............ O-One more run!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, Shakur-chan! Good morning!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what kind of training is that even 
supposed to be? How many times are you 
gonna do the exact same thing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This? It's a stamina-building menu that 
Trainer came up with!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When I asked for advice on building 
stamina before, I was told that running 
consecutive short distances would do the 
trick!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's a damn limit, y'know! Weren't you 
told to do around three sets at most?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Just how many damn hours... have you been 
doing that... huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That was... because I still had plenty of 
stamina left over!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you... There's no way you're gonna 
see results with such an unbalanced 
routine! Just take a look!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What is this video?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I take a video every morning for my own 
records. Look, you're in the corner of the 
frame too..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, seriously...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Did the number of sets just 
increase...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I can handle a lot more now 
than I used to!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're the only one who's gonna grow from 
this, y'know...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No, is this instruction taking that into 
account as well...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that's it! Everything must be 
going just according to Trainer's plan! 
Heheh!
